'''Propellant-based lateral thrusters''' was a [[Engine/Legends|propulsion]] technology used by [[Airbus/Legends|air buses]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. By [[22 BBY/Legends|13:3:28]], a study by [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|Rhire Medical Academy]] recommended replacing air buses with propellant-based lateral thrusters with variants equipped with more modern [[directional-repulsorlift steering]] technology in an effort to combat air pollution and associated respiratory disease.<ref name="HNN 49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_4.html|Study: Pollution Standards Still Endanger Many}}</ref>
